entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Information element included by the UE in WB-S1 mode when the UE radio capability ID was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message that may request the UE radio capability ID from the UE.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID requested
entities.description: Condition where the UE radio capability ID was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE is operating in WB-S1 mode.

relations.description: The SECURITY MODE COMMAND message may establish the condition that the UE radio capability ID was requested.
Inclusion of the UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that it was requested in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Inclusion of the UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is in WB-S1 mode.
